log.msg: Qwen (qwen2.5-coder:7b) is designing the kitchen - under a minute
Applying the MagickHome rule book: module sizes for this kitchen size and shape
Applying design rules: window, door, corner and chimney clearances
Building the 3D scene: cabinets, appliances, countertops, panels

raw.room_reading: The room is a large U-shape with solid walls and a large window on Wall 2. The customer prefers an U-layout with tall storage, has no specific needs for water purifier, glass display, or open shelf unit, and does not specify a cooking style
raw.design_plan: The design will feature a large U-shape with a hob on Wall 3 and a sink on Wall 2. The base cabinets will be a mix of drawers and shutters, with tall storage units above the wall cabinets.
raw.layout_why: The U-shape provides ample space for cooking and storage, and the hob on Wall 3 and sink on Wall 2 meet the customer's preferences.
raw.sink_why: The customer prefers the sink on Wall 2.
raw.hob_why: The hob is placed on Wall 3 as per the customer's choice.
raw.lpg_why: LPG is assumed and the Base Cylinder Unit is included.
raw.purifier_why: The customer does not specify a water purifier, so it will not be included.
raw.display_why: The customer does not specify a glass display, so it will not be included.
raw.open_why: The customer does not specify an open shelf unit, so it will not be included.
raw.features_why: The customer wants tall storage units above the wall cabinets.
raw.wall_cabinets_why: The customer does not specify a preference for wall cabinets.
raw.wall_style_why: The customer does not specify a preference for wall cabinet doors.
raw.finish_why: The customer does not specify a preference for finishes.
raw.loft_why: The customer does not specify a preference for lofts.

customer_needs: - Door style Slab (Plain); layout preference U; wants tall storage.
- Water purifier: water purifier not stated.
- Gas: not stated - LPG is assumed, so the cylinder unit is included (rule R11).
- Built-in appliances: built-in appliances not stated.
- Glass display: glass display not stated.
- Cooking: cooking style not stated; household size not stated.
- Base cabinets: base cabinet style not stated - you choose drawers, mixed or shutters.
- Wall cabinets: door type not stated - you choose hinged shutters or lift-up; open shelf unit not stated.
- Finishes: base run not stated - you choose; wall run not stated - you choose (the codes allowed are the ones the budget tier permits).

explanation.why: The customer does not specify a preference for finishes.

Wall run (wall units + lofts): Blue Haze (PU matte, Magickhome) - chosen by the designer
Tall units take the base-run finish and lofts take the wall-run finish (finish continuity).
Fillers, slabs, end panels and cover panels take the finish of the run they close (workbook: Filler Panel / Cover End Panel finish must match the cabinets).
rules: No budget stated: any finish allowed

explanation.why: Corners take only corner cabinets, facing the room; a corner stays open when a door or window leaves no room for one.
